title: Widen the decision record: source, decidedBy, scope, adrs, supersedes, plus rejected and withdrawn (seq 179c)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (c), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md at main.

The decision record grows the fields the design names -- source, decidedBy, scope, adrs and supersedes -- and the statuses rejected and withdrawn. Today the record cannot express who ruled, what a ruling binds, or what it supersedes, which is why opum-doc built a separate grants/*.json store (QCLI-335).

Existing records must keep reading as they do now; a widened record that makes an old one unreadable is not the change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The decision record carries source, decidedBy, scope, adrs and supersedes, settable and readable through the CLI
rejected and withdrawn are reachable statuses for a decision
A decision record written before these fields existed still reads correctly
The fields appear in the machine contract and the human rendering
